offers_products.reason: Sells subscription data, research, indexes and software platforms (Morningstar Direct, PitchBook, Morningstar Data) as main offerings.

offers_services.reason: Provides investment management and advisory services, credit ratings (DBRS Morningstar) and retirement advice alongside research.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Individual investors buy Morningstar Investor subscriptions, and the site serves consumers with free articles and portfolio tools.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Asset managers, advisors, banks and institutions buy PitchBook, Morningstar Direct, data, indexes and credit ratings.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most revenue is subscription licences for PitchBook, Direct and data, plus asset-based fees and ratings surveillance.

cyclical_demand.reason: Subscription research and data are core tools for investment firms, with sticky renewals; asset-based fees move with markets but are not postponed.

big_ticket.reason: Annual subscriptions and fees are small, frequent recurring payments, not large one-time purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers mainly pay for proprietary data, software platforms and ratings brands, not staff hours.

large_customers.reason: Customers are mixed: asset managers, advisors, private equity firms and individual investors, not mainly large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Data, research and software business needs little physical investment; growth comes from analysts, technology and acquisitions.

notes: Customer mix across advisors, asset managers, institutions and individuals makes the large-customer answer a judgement call.
